newsitem.title: GREECE: National Invest H1 profit up 190pct to 1.9 bln drs.
newsitem.headline: National Invest H1 profit up 190pct to 1.9 bln drs.

text.p: Greek closed-end fund National Invest, a state National Bank subsidiary, said in a statement that its first-half 1997 profit grew 190 percent to 1.9 billion drachmas from 654 million a year earlier.
Lower expenses, reflecting synergies from the absorbtion in late 1996 of listed International Portfolio Investment Company, an affiliated closed-end fund, helped improve the results, the fund said.
Profits continued to rise fast in July, exceeding 2.0 billion drachmas with its portfolio having unrealised gains of some 2.2 billion, National Invest said.
As of end-June, the fund was invested 70 percent in Greek stocks.
"The 70 percent participation of Greek equities in our portfolio reflects the trust of the company and the National Bank group to the long-term prospects of the Greek capital market," it said.
